photos_removed_ck.name: photos_removed_ck
photos_removed_ck.value: ("photos"."removed_at" is null and "photos"."removed_by" is null and "photos"."removed_reason" is null and "photos"."data" is not null) or ("photos"."removed_at" is not null and "photos"."removed_by" is not null and "photos"."removed_reason" is not null and "photos"."data" is null)

cats_discoverer_ck.name: cats_discoverer_ck
cats_discoverer_ck.value: "cats"."discoverer_device_id" is not null or "cats"."redacted_at" is not null

sightings_attribution_ck.name: sightings_attribution_ck
sightings_attribution_ck.value: "sightings"."device_id" is not null or "sightings"."redacted_at" is not null

observations_attribution_ck.name: observations_attribution_ck
observations_attribution_ck.value: "observations"."redacted_at" is not null or ("observations"."device_id" is null) <> ("observations"."account_id" is null)

feeding_sites_public_needs_label_ck.name: feeding_sites_public_needs_label_ck
feeding_sites_public_needs_label_ck.value: not "feeding_sites"."is_public" or ("feeding_sites"."public_label" is not null and "feeding_sites"."public_id" is not null)

person_scopes_start_ck.name: person_scopes_start_ck
person_scopes_start_ck.value: "person_scopes"."reach" <> 'start' OR ("person_scopes"."role" = 'guardian' AND "person_scopes"."colony_id" IS NULL AND "person_scopes"."expires_at" IS NULL AND "person_scopes"."relationship" IS NULL)

welfare_reports_position_ck.name: welfare_reports_position_ck
welfare_reports_position_ck.value: "welfare_reports"."kind" <> 'welfare' or ("welfare_reports"."lat" is not null and "welfare_reports"."lng" is not null)

welfare_reports_photo_reason_photo_ck.name: welfare_reports_photo_reason_photo_ck
welfare_reports_photo_reason_photo_ck.value: "welfare_reports"."reason" is null or "welfare_reports"."reason" not in ('photo_private', 'photo_inappropriate', 'photo_not_cat') or "welfare_reports"."photo_id" is not null

photo_visibility_events_author_ck.name: photo_visibility_events_author_ck
photo_visibility_events_author_ck.value: ("photo_visibility_events"."person_id" is not null and "photo_visibility_events"."author" = "photo_visibility_events"."person_id"::text) or ("photo_visibility_events"."person_id" is null and "photo_visibility_events"."author" ~ '^report:.+$')
